blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. When you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting, you need simple, everyday English. This lesson is called Laptop vs Desktop.

A desktop is bigger. It stays on your table and does not move. A laptop is smaller. You can carry it to a meeting or take it home. Some laptops are fast, and some desktops are faster.

Which one is better for you? It is a good question. A bigger screen is nice for long work. A smaller computer is easy to carry. James from IT can help you choose. Go slow — one step at a time. You can do it!

items.q: Which offices does IT support?
options: Every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo
items.why: "IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo."

items.q: What is true about a desktop?
options: It is bigger and stays on your table
It is very small and easy to carry
items.why: "A desktop is bigger. It stays on your table and does not move."

items.q: What can you do with a laptop?
options: Carry it to a meeting or take it home
items.why: "A laptop is smaller. You can carry it to a meeting or take it home."

items.q: The text suggests that a laptop is a good choice for someone who…
options: needs to move around and travel
items.why: Inferência: o laptop é pequeno e fácil de carregar — bom para quem se move.

items.q: What would the author most likely say about choosing a computer?
options: The best choice depends on what you need
There is only one right answer for everyone
items.why: Inferência: o texto mostra vantagens dos dois e diz que James pode ajudar você a escolher.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James, do suporte de TI, ajudar um usuário a escolher. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, I'm James from IT support. Let me help you choose your new computer. It is easy — just tell me how you work.

Do you sit at the same table every day? Then a desktop is good for you. A desktop is bigger, and it has a bigger screen. It is nice for long work. It stays on your table, so you do not carry it.

Do you go to many meetings? Do you work at home sometimes? Then a laptop is better. A laptop is smaller, so it is easy to carry. You can take it to a meeting or take it home.

And speed? Some laptops are fast. Some desktops are faster. For most people, both are fast enough for email and online meetings.

So, think about your day. If you move a lot, take the laptop. If you stay at your table, take the desktop. Call me if you have a question. Go slow, one step at a time. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking?
items.why: "Hi, I'm James from IT support."

items.q: According to James, a desktop is good for someone who…
options: sits at the same table every day
items.why: "Do you sit at the same table every day? Then a desktop is good for you."

items.q: Why does James say a laptop is easy to carry?
items.why: "A laptop is smaller, so it is easy to carry."

items.q: James suggests that, for most people, speed is…
options: not the main problem, because both are fast enough
a reason to buy two computers
items.why: Inferência: "For most people, both are fast enough for email and online meetings."

items.q: How would you describe James's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ele explica com calma, dá exemplos e termina com "You can do it!"

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The desktop stays on my table all day." A desktop is…
options: a computer that stays on a table
items.why: Desktop = computador de mesa, fica na mesa.

items.q: "I take my laptop to every meeting." A laptop is…
items.why: Laptop = notebook, um computador que você carrega.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The new screen is ___ than the old one, so I can see more."
items.why: Bigger = maior; uma tela maior mostra mais.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A laptop is ___ than a desktop, so it is easy to carry."
items.why: Smaller = menor; por isso é fácil de carregar.

items.q: "The new computer is faster than the old one." Faster means…
items.why: Faster = mais rápido.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que você ouve no suporte de TI. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please turn on your computer." To turn on means to…
items.why: Turn on = ligar.

items.q: "Can you log in with your name and password?" To log in means to…
items.why: Log in = entrar na conta.

items.q: "Let's set up your new laptop today." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = preparar/configurar para usar.

items.q: "If it is slow, please restart it." To restart means to…
options: turn it off and on again
items.why: Restart = reiniciar (desligar e ligar de novo).

items.q: "I will help you out with the meeting." To help someone out means to…
items.why: Help out = ajudar alguém.
